BiblicalUsage: Resen lay between Nineveh and Calah, and the same is a great city, built in the land of Asshur in the days after the flood. Nineveh, Calah and Resen rose together from one stock, and the great city is named beside them.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold from this is that the great cities of the old world are named so we remember that empires rise and fall, but the record stands.
